title: 逆転裁判2
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written

The script is Gyakuten Saiban's (games/gba/AGB-ASBJ.lua) at this game's addresses, found offline in snaps: the word that walks the script, the section's start, the build's words. Eight commands met here and not in the first game take lengths read off the first scene's script

The table: the whole font, 1,412 characters. 1,191 glyphs are bit for bit a glyph of Gyakuten Saiban's font and take its reading (read once there, by one reader); 221 were read here off sheets, once. Four are left out. No second reader has read it

Played from power-on into the first episode's trial. What the script said in play agreed with the rows read off 89 of 89 pictures, over 3 scenes (38, 8 and 43 screens), choices' questions among them. No screen without text was among them
The rows given for each screen were the script's pages, each held against its picture and found the same: the comparison checks pages and their order more than it checks the characters
notes: Read by the script games/gba/AGB-A3GJ.lua. A scene's script lies unpacked in the board's 256 KB; a word in the CPU's 32 KB says where it has got to. A page is said when that stands on a wait or a choice; a choice's answers are said with it (channel choice) where they follow in the script. Who speaks: the speaker's number only, the tab's name being a picture. Not looked at: answers of a choice kept elsewhere, the cursor, the court record, cross-examination, saved games. Pages that go on by themselves (the dream) weren't compared.
